3. Phase A: Fixture Vision

Phase A of the fixture turns a request into an approved statement of work.

3.1 Objectives

  • Develop a high-level vision of the value to be delivered
  • Obtain approval for a statement of work

3.2 Approach

Start from the request, find the stakeholders, agree the scope, write the vision.

3.3 Inputs

  • Request for fixture work
  • Fixture principles
  • Populated fixture repository

3.4 Steps

  1. Establish the project
  2. Identify stakeholders and their concerns
    • use a stakeholder map
  3. Define scope
  4. Develop the vision and the statement of work

3.5 Outputs

  • Approved statement of fixture work
  • Fixture vision
OutputWhere it goes
Statement of workSponsor | governance board
VisionRepository
